title: gastrochilus parviflorus
intro: Gastrochilus parviflorus, commonly known as the "Small-flowered Ghost Orchid", is a species of orchid native to the Himalayas and parts of Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as skin infections and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus parviflorus include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit microbial growth, and exhibit antioxidant activity, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
